title: SpaceX Now Out-Launches Every Other Country
source: Global orbital launch attempts by year (newspace.im / Payload Space launch trackers) vs. SpaceX's own annual Falcon 9 + Starship orbital launch count (Space.com, AIAA, BryceTech's 2025 launch report). SpaceX flew 165 orbital missions in 2025 alone — roughly 51% of the ~329 orbital launch attempts worldwide that year, more than every other country combined (China ~90, Russia ~17, and the rest smaller still).
